title: EPFO Raipur Celebrates Foundation Day with Grandeur, Cultural Festivities - पीआईबी
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau Ministry of Labour & Employment EPFO Raipur Celebrates Foundation Day with Grandeur, Cultural Festivities Officials, employees and their family members participate enthusiastically; Regional Provident Fund Commissioner honours performers Foundation Day message publicised across 25 districts through ‘Nidhi Aapke Nikat’ outreach programmes Posted On: 03 NOV 2026 5:16PM by PIB Raipur Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), Regional Office, Raipur, celebrated its Foundation Day with enthusiasm and fervour, organising a series of activities, public awareness initiatives and cultural programmes. The celebrations highlighted the organisation’s institutional journey while promoting a spirit of unity, mutual cooperation and collective commitment among its officers, employees and their families. As part of the celebrations, the Regional Office premises were attractively decorated, with special lighting arrangements illuminating the campus in the evening. Informative banners were also displayed at prominent locations within the office परिसर to familiarise visiting subscribers and other stakeholders with the organisation’s Foundation Day and its journey over the years. A grand cultural evening was organised on October 30, 2026, with the participation of officers, employees and their family members. The programme featured a series of cultural and creative performances by staff members and their families, adding colour and vibrancy to the celebrations. The performances received an encouraging response from the audience. The programme was presided over by Regional Provident Fund Commissioner-I Jayvadan Ingle. At the conclusion of the event, he appreciated the talent, enthusiasm and efforts of the participants and felicitated them with mementoes and prizes in recognition of their performances. The Foundation Day celebrations were also publicised across Chhattisgarh through the organisation’s district-level outreach programmes. During October 2026, special banners highlighting the Foundation Day and the organisation’s role were displayed at ‘Nidhi Aapke Nikat’ programmes organised in 25 districts of the state. The initiative helped disseminate information about the organisation among subscribers and members of the public. The celebrations at the Regional Office, Raipur, reflected the organisation’s commitment to fostering an inclusive and collaborative work culture.
